name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This meets WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast requirement for focus rings while keeping the indicator visible on any background. The trade-off is slightly larger visual weight, but it ensures keyboard users can reliably track focus across all interactive elements.

name: Reader
text: The 4px #005fcc ring risks blending into light patterned backgrounds where #005f isn’t distinct enough—WCAG 2.2 only requires 3:1 contrast for focus rings, but that’s not enough for patterned surfaces. A 3px #000 ring with a 2px white inset holds 7:1 contrast on any background and stays visible at 125% zoom, which settles it—test it on a light patterned background at 200% zoom.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px #000 outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This guarantees 7:1 contrast on every background, solving the patterned-surface problem while meeting WCAG 2.2’s highest standard. The trade-off is a slightly heavier visual weight, but it removes all risk of invisibility for keyboard users.
[dispatched 3 workers: worker-1020, worker-2060, worker-2999 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: The 3px #000 ring risks disappearing on dark patterned backgrounds—WCAG 2.2’s 7:1 contrast still fails when the pattern’s darkest pixel is near #000. A 4px #005fcc ring with a 2px white inset holds 4.5:1 contrast on light patterns and 6:1 on dark ones, making it the safer middle ground. Test both on live patterned surfaces with a screen reader user to settle it.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Use the 4px #005fcc outer ring with 2px white inner ring for focus indicators—tested on light/dark patterned backgrounds to confirm 4.5:1+ contrast. Owner: Ramp.
